name: Meron Tadesse
text: PRIMA completely transformed my relationship with food. Within six months I went from home cook to sous chef at a respected restaurant in Addis. The instructors genuinely care about your growth.
outcome: Now Sous Chef at Yod Abyssinia

name: Abdi Tola
text: The hands-on bar sessions and storytelling around each spirit made the course unforgettable. I launched my own cocktail bar in Bole within months of graduating.

name: Hanna Gebremedhin
text: The instructors don't just teach skills — they teach professionalism. My portfolio opened doors I never imagined. I'm now working with top Ethiopian celebrities and fashion events.

name: Kedija Ahmed
text: The pattern-making module alone was worth the entire programme. I developed my own aesthetic language blending Ethiopian heritage with modern design. Truly world-class teaching.

name: Hussen Mohammed
text: The passion for coffee here is infectious. The sensory training sessions were eye-opening — I can never drink coffee the same way again. My specialty café opened 3 months after graduating.

name: Selam Worku
text: The technical precision pushed me to levels I didn't think possible. The chocolate and sugar arts module was pure magic. Every week I was amazed at what I could create.
